# mpadge.eu

> Personal site of Mark Padgham: open-source software developer (C++, R, JavaScript, Rust), reformed academic, developer of the UrbanAnalyst platform, and former lead of software peer-review for rOpenSci. The blog covers programming in R and C++, open-source software communities, and the effects of AI on code and society.

All software is open-source. Code is hosted on GitHub, Codeberg, Codefloe, SourceHut and tangled (all as `mpadge`). Mastodon: https://nerdculture.de/@mpadge

## Main pages

- [About](https://mpadge.eu/about/): Background, availability for hire, and about this site
- [Blog](https://mpadge.eu/blog/): All blog posts
- [Code](https://mpadge.eu/code/): Software packages developed
- [Privacy](https://mpadge.eu/privacy/): Privacy policy
- [RSS feed](https://mpadge.eu/feed.xml): Blog feed

## Blog: AI and open-source communities

- [Coding Alone](https://mpadge.eu/blog/coding-alone.html): Open-source software is increasingly built and maintained by single developers in isolation, accelerated by AI coding tools; this trajectory is not inevitable
- [Machina machista](https://mpadge.eu/blog/machina-machista.html): LLM recommendations in decision-making scenarios are far more escalatory for male than female actors, and default to "male"
- [Purposeful joy](https://mpadge.eu/blog/purposeful-joy.html): AI replaceability, purpose, and joy as a non-capturable resource
- [Centralisation, reversibility, and restarting](https://mpadge.eu/blog/centralisation-reversibility.html): Technical centralisation is reversible; economic and political centralisation is not
